recommendations.title: Reinforce the canopy corridor with one extra soft enclosure beat
recommendations.rationale: The canopy track reads slightly lighter than the transition zone, which softens the sense of moving under stronger forest cover.
recommendations.recommendedAdjustment: Trial one additional shrub or understory support placement within CANOPY_TRACK_ZONE so the corridor feels more enclosed without crowding the walking lane.
recommendations.deterministicGuardrail: Tie any added placement to the existing canopy-track seed band and preserve the current readable movement corridor.

recommendations.title: Strengthen the clearing-to-backdrop payoff with a secondary curiosity beat
recommendations.rationale: The route has a valid clearing anchor, but the same accent-tree family is currently doing most of the discovery work across both destination zones.
recommendations.recommendedAdjustment: Add one small supporting point of interest near the clearing edge or deep-margin threshold so the later half of the walk feels more intentionally staged.
recommendations.deterministicGuardrail: Keep the existing clearing anchor tree as the primary focal beat and avoid introducing unsupported assets.
